scope: owner-shared combat report summaries for current members of the owner's current alliance in the same active world
share_action: explicit owner action per combat report
revoke_action: owner may revoke an active share at any time
perspective: derive every outcome and total from the owner's own combat side; for ACS, use only that owner's attacker wing. Refuse sharing when the owner's units cannot be separated from allied garrisons.
excluded_fields: report, mission, target, account and colony identifiers
target name, player name, coordinates and exact timestamp
opponent units, losses, survivors and defenses
loot, resources, raw report title/body and raw combat object
replay seed, commitment, digests and hidden intelligence
retention: until owner revokes, owner leaves/is removed from alliance, or alliance/world is deleted
